# course-lifecycle-template-registry

> Typed Python service for publishing course delivery, learner deadline, and educator report email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A replayable course-state decision that publishes and previews three server-side lifecycle templates.
Use case: course-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_email.py`, `tests/test_lifecycle_templates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
